    *   `Discount_Coupons`: Stores discount info.

    *   `Products_Booked`: Links bookings to products. Contains `booking_id`, `product_id`, `returned_yn`, `returned_late_yn`, `booked_count`, `booked_amount`.
    *   `View_Product_Availability`: Links products to bookings. Contains `product_id`, `booking_id`, `status_date`, `available_yn`.
